newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures end mixed, S&Ps up slightly.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures end mixed, S&Ps up slightly.

text.p: Sept 26 - U.S. stock index futures ended mixed, with S&Ps closing slightly higher. One firm bid prices up, but overall trade was quiet late. Dec S&Ps seen range-bound in the final days of the quarter, traders said. Dec may have to fall to 690.00 before attracting good buying. Fair value is at 5.65. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
